05 — Featured project · Brand identity concept

Paul John. Matured in Goa.

A self-initiated identity concept for an Indian single malt: positioning, a three-voice type system, packaging, pattern and campaign, all from one idea. Heat as the maker, with my type-and-subtitle twist on top.

Click through the prototype ↗
Idea

Brand idea

“Crafted in India. Matured in Goa.” The concept opens with a place-led promise and a bold wordmark.

System

Positioning & visual vocabulary

Not borrowed heritage, an Indian original. A three-voice type system (Outfit for impact, Cormorant Garamond italic for poetry, IBM Plex Mono for facts) and a palette taken from Goa’s coast.

Packaging

Four expressions, one voice

Nirvana, Brilliance, Edited and Bold share one label hierarchy: name, echo, character, tasting subtitles, origin. Colour changes the mood while the system stays constant.

Pack & pattern

Bottle and pattern

Dark glass, a copper closure and a luminous amber label. The repeating sun tile is a quiet signature for cartons, tissue and tasting collateral.

Campaign

Campaign posters

“Goa turns up the heat.” Repeated type fades like heat in the air, and tasting notes are set as film subtitles, a nod to my background in kinetic type.

Click through the prototype ↗

An independent creative exploration, not official brand guidelines. Identity, packaging and campaign messaging are proposals, not approved brand assets, and packaging is illustrative. Bengaluru refers to John Distilleries’ company origin; the whisky is made in Goa. For adults of legal drinking age only.
